what: What were the town's non-union salary grades and step rates in 2000?
why: `salary-schedule` and `report-classification-plan` read Schedule A from the 2010 report and FY2011 onward. The 2000 annual town report prints neither: its text was searched on every page (1-136) for salary schedule, classification plan, schedule A, pay schedule and grade, and returned only the legend line `sal adj-FY 00 Pay Schedule Adjustment` under the accountant's schedule (p76), school grade levels, and the DEGREE/STEP labels beside each school employee's gross in the payroll report (p127-p134) -- labels with no rate (sources/data/report-tables/2000/). — closes: the Personnel Bylaw Schedule A (salary schedule and classification plan) in force for FY2001, from the Town Clerk or the Personnel Committee, and the school salary schedules in the teachers' and support staff contracts for 2000-01.

what: How many weighing and measuring devices did the Sealer test in 2000, and what did sealing bring in by device?
why: `report-weights-measures` holds the Sealer's device counts and fees from the 2010 report. The 2000 annual town report prints no Inspector of Weights & Measures report: its text was searched on every page (1-136) for weights, sealer and sealing and returned only the appointment (p9), the receipts line SEALING FEES $1,014.00 (p68), the appropriation line Inspector Weights & Measures (p73), the omnibus line Sealer of Wgts & Measures (p106) and the inspector's gross in the payroll report (p126) (sources/data/report-tables/2000/). — closes: the Sealer of Weights and Measures' 2000 annual report to the Division of Standards.

what: How much of Lunenburg's debt at 30 June 2000 sat inside the debt limit, and how much outside it?
why: `outstanding-debt` reads this from the five-year outstanding-debt summary the FY2011-FY2025 reports print. The 2000 annual town report prints its bonded indebtedness issue by issue (PDF page 84) and a repayment schedule (p89) whose principal lines carry an exempt share for two issues (`PRINCIPAL (82% EXEMPT)`, and one Textract reads `(09% EXEMPT)`) but no summary by purpose and no debt-limit split: its text was searched on every page for debt limit, outstanding debt and indebtedness and returned only those two pages, the index (p3) and a committee's list of what it wants from proposals, which asks for `Schedules of estimated borrowing both inside and outside of the debt limits` (p30). — closes: the Town's FY2000 Statement of Indebtedness as filed with the Division of Local Services.
